title: \(\operatorname{ex}(Q_8,C_4)=680\)
statement: The maximum number of edges in a C₄-free subgraph of the eight-dimensional cube Q₈ is 680.

counterexample.description: A 681-edge subgraph of the 8-dimensional cube containing no 4-cycle. A witness is an edge list plus exhaustive 4-cycle checking. The paper reports 1,076 unsuccessful independent searches at 681 edges.
